title: Concept: OS command executed from a string in groovy — review required
description: In groovy, a command string is executed through the GDK convenience method. The method delegates to the shell, so quoting is the only defence and it is fragile across platforms. Jenkins pipelines frequently reach this shape when a parameter is interpolated into a shell step.
applicability: groovy scripts and pipeline steps that call system tools.
risk: Arbitrary command execution with application privileges; HIGH severity.
